title: Diagram and tensor comparisons from a lifted finite presentation matrix
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, $B:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram of finite-type integer algebras [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and $\kappa_i:B_i\to S$ any ring cocone. Let $M$ be an $S$-module and let $S^m\xrightarrow{g}S^n\xrightarrow{f}M\to0$ be a finite free presentation: $f$ is surjective and $\operatorname{im}(g)=\ker(f)$. Fix $i_0\in I$ and a matrix $A_0\in\operatorname{Mat}_{n\times m}(B_{i_0})$ whose image under $\kappa_{i_0}$ is the standard-basis matrix of $g$. Then there exist a nonempty directed preorder $J$, a final functor $F:J\to I$, an abelian-group diagram $D:J\to\mathrm{Ab}$ and a cocone $\nu_j:D_j\to M$, with $B_{Fj}$-module structures on $D_j$, such that each $D_j$ is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], transitions and cocone legs respect scalars through $B(F(i\to j))$ and $\kappa_{Fj}$, and the maps $B_{Fj}\otimes_{B_{Fi}}D_i\to D_j$ and $S\otimes_{B_{Fj}}D_j\to M$ sending $y\otimes x$ to $y$ times the indicated image of $x$ are linear isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. If $I,B,S$ live in universe $u$ and $M$ in universe $v$, take $J$ in $u$ and $D_j$ in $v$. No ring or module colimit assertion [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Take J = {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} with its induced preorder and let F be the monotone inclusion. A common upper bound proves directedness and gives a morphism from each original object to an object of J. Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered proves finality; the parallel-arrow condition is immediate because a preorder category is thin.

For j in J let A_j be the entrywise transition image of A₀ and Q_j = B(Fj)^n / range(A_j.toLin'). The private coordinates_matrix lemma shows that the semilinear coordinate map intertwines the matrix maps. The private presentationLift definition uses Submodule.liftQ to descend f composed with coordinate change; exactness kills the relations. Apply it to the quotient projections to define transitions and to the given presentation to define the cocone legs. Ring-functor composition and cocone naturality imply equality of these maps on coordinate representatives; surjectivity of quotient projection then proves functor and cocone laws. Semilinearity proves both scalar compatibility clauses.

Finite powers and their quotients are finite modules. Algebra.FiniteType.small over ℤ directly proves that every B(Fj) is Small in universe v. Module.Finite.small proves Q_j is Small in v. Let D_j = Shrink.{v} Q_j and transport transitions and legs using the actual linear equivalences E_j : D_j ≃ₗ Q_j. The maps p_j = E_j.symm composed with quotient projection are surjective; their representative formulas establish all transported identities. The Module.Finite instance on Shrink proves finiteness.

The private presentation_baseChange lemma applies IsBaseChange.of_right_exact to the source quotient presentation and a target finite free presentation. The vertical free-module coordinate maps are base changes by IsBaseChange.linearMap and IsBaseChange.finitePow; coordinates_matrix establishes the matrix square, and the quotient representative formula establishes the quotient square. Tensor right exactness therefore proves the induced quotient map is base change. Apply this first to p_j and its matrix presentation for each transition, and then to f,g over S for each cocone leg. IsBaseChange.comp_equiv transports the source through E_i or E_j. IsBaseChange.equiv and equiv_tmul provide precisely the required linear equivalences and pure-tensor formulas.
